name: Does repairing molding also involve drywall repair and painting?

mainEntity.name: Does repairing molding also involve drywall repair and painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Molding repairs often require blending work into the adjacent drywall and paint. When baseboards or door casings are removed or re-secured, drywall paper can tear, or gaps can appear along uneven walls. A full-service remodeling contractor handles the finish carpentry alongside drywall patching, precision caulking, and paint touch-ups as a single scope. If you hire a standalone carpenter who does not offer painting or drywall finishing, you will need to complete the wall preparation and color blending yourself.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, repairing or replacing molding often requires drywall patching, caulking along seams, and paint blending to ensure seamless integration with adjacent surfaces.
